children: According to Sina Finance, Robinhood said in a post on X that its services are gradually recovering after an AWS outage, and the company will continue monitoring the situation and share updates as needed. Its status page said AWS separately confirmed operational issues with Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud services in the U.S. East 1 region, and engineers are actively working on the problem and have seen early signs of recovery.

title: Robinhood Says Services Are Recovering After AWS Outage
